priorities.summary: Cisco Nexus 3000 and 9000 Series switches: an unauthenticated, remote attacker can execute arbitrary code via crafted MPLS OAM packets, disclosed in Cisco's October 7 NX-OS security bundle. Switches are management-plane-adjacent, so patching should take priority in enterprise networks.

Cisco NX-OS Software NX-API remote code execution: unauthenticated attackers can run arbitrary commands with elevated privileges through the NX-API interface on Nexus switches. Part of the same October 7 Cisco bundle; exposed management APIs make this a strong wormable target.

IBM Security Verify Access 10.0 through 10.0.9.2 and IBM Verify Identity Access 11.0 through 11.0.3: an insecure deserialization flaw lets a remote unauthenticated attacker execute arbitrary code, disclosed October 8. Identity infrastructure is a crown jewel, so treat this as an emergency patch.

model.name: OpenAI GPT-6 rollout + Intelligent UI
model.summary: OpenAI rolled GPT-6 out to all ChatGPT tiers on October 7 (GPT-6 Sol for paid plans, GPT-6 Luna for Free/Go) alongside 'Intelligent UI', which lets the model answer with interactive charts, tappable buttons, forms and generated mini-tools instead of plain text. For ChatGPT's 1.2 billion weekly users, it is the biggest visible change to the interface since the product launched.
